question: The International Cricket Council (ICC) Board announced a minimum age policy for International cricket in November 2020. As per the policy, a player must be at least __________ to play cricket globally.
solution:
The correct answer is __**15 years old.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The International Cricket Council (ICC) Board announced a minimum age policy for International cricket in November 2020. 
 
• As per the policy, a player must be at least **15 years old to play cricket globally.**
 
• To improve the safeguarding of players, the International Cricket Council (ICC) has introduced a 'minimum age policy' in International Cricket. A player should be at least 15 years old to play International Cricket. However, countries still have the option to field a player below the said age limit. 
 
• In case of exceptional circumstances, a Member Board could apply to the ICC to allow a player under the age of 15 to play for their respective country. 
 
• Hasan Raza of Pakistan holds the record of being the youngest cricketer to play International Cricket.
 
 
• He made his Test debut when he was **14 years and 227 days old.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The International Cricket Council (ICC), the international governing body of Cricket founded in 1909 by representatives from England, Australia, and South Africa, was initially known as Imperial Cricket Conference.
 
• In 1965, it was renamed as International Cricket Conference and in 1965, it was renamed the International Cricket Council (ICC) in 1989.
